instrument: Regulation (EU) 2023/2854 on harmonised rules on fair access to and use of data (Data Act)
applicationNote: In application since 12 September 2025. One obligation is still future: Article 3(1) applies only to connected products and related services placed on the market after 12 September 2026 (Article 50).
note: 50 Articles, no Annexes — verified against the EUR-Lex DOM on 2026-08-15. Text is taken from the ORIGINAL act (CELEX 32023R2854). EUR-Lex does list a consolidated version dated 2023-12-22 — the same day as OJ publication, i.e. the initial version, since the Data Act has not been amended — but it does not serve that CELEX through the HTML endpoint (02023R2854-20231222 returns 'the requested document does not exist'), so the original act is the only retrievable form. 'consolidatedAs' is set to that same 2023-12-22, which keeps reg:drift's comparison meaningful: a real amendment will list a later date. Application dates read directly from Article 50. Text is reused from EUR-Lex under CC BY 4.0 (Commission Decision 2011/833/EU).
